assumptions: Metrics are computed over deduplicated retrieved ids while preserving the first occurrence from the raw ranking.
Scores are retained only for provenance; Recall, MRR, NDCG, and HitRate are computed from ranked order.
Binary relevance is used unless graded relevance scores are explicitly present in the labels file.
Loose union uses the flattened union of gold_chunk_ids and silver_chunk_ids for binary ranking metrics.
Strict union hit uses gold hit OR strict silver-group hit, where strict silver-group hit requires retrieving an entire silver_chunk_group inside top-k.
Labels were generated inside this repo from the run's selected QA entries and exact chunk boundaries for this experiment.
Selected retrieval payload JSONL because it preserves ranked chunk ids, scores, and query metadata.
Primary relevance uses gold_chunk_ids. Queries without gold labels are left null rather than back-filled from silver labels.
